items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Bill Robinson walked up, put his hand in his pocket, and gave this cop money, if I'm lyin'.

ctx.x: ...... Not only that, our soloist and our set was the first Negro band to open at the Strand Theatre downtown... During the intermission, you know you walk out in a little fresh air, there was a cop on the corner. Bill Robinson walked up, put his hand in his pocket, and gave this cop money, if I'm lyin'. I hope I'll never play a note. The cop said, "What is this for?" He said, "My name is Bojangles."
Just like that? He gave the money away?
